sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Tesla chief executive Elon Musk has announced that production of the Cybertruck will wind down around the middle of next year at its Texas factory. sections.heading: Why it matters

sections.text: Amanda Mathewson, a childminder in Dunfermline, was jailed for two years after pleading guilty to wilfully neglecting and abandoning children.
